title: Stash early cash under the floorboards
body: You don't get a bank account until the mission "Buck Me". Until then, hide cash under the loose floorboards in Jason's bedroom. Money you carry can be lost if you die or get arrested.

title: Work the night shift
body: Press up on the D-pad to check the time on your phone. Streets empty out at night, which can make police responses easier to deal with. Sleep at Jason's house to skip ahead.

title: Focus on doors: white is open, red is alarmed
body: Aim Focus Mode at a door to check it. White means you can walk in; red means it's alarmed. Doors at the back of shop floors often lead to hidden rooms and staircases, and the minimap shows whether a door is locked for good.

title: Read the blue buildings
body: On the world map, darker blue buildings have an entrance or interior; lighter blue ones don't. Up close, the minimap marks doors you can use with a white line.

title: Early Focus buff: feed Dolores
body: Feed Jason's pet snake, Dolores, and watch her eat her mouse. It's a quick boost to Focus Mode early in the game.

title: Call the mechanic to the roadside
body: After the mission "Just A Scratch", you can usually call your mechanic from wherever you are to fix a damaged car for a fee. No more limping to a garage.

title: Buy a suppressor early
body: Launch guides report that Ammu-Nation sells suppressors for most guns and that they're affordable early on. Quieter work means fewer witnesses.

sources.label: GamerBolt — 20 things to know before you start

title: Change your clothes and your car
body: Guides report that police remember your outfit and your vehicle. After a job, swap both and you'll be far harder to find.

title: Save manually before big missions
body: Launch guides say mission replay isn't available at launch, and players are confused about how auto-save behaves. Make a manual save before anything important.

sources.label: TechRadar — Launch-day live: auto save confusion

title: Focus Mode slows the moment
body: Click both sticks to trigger Focus Mode. With a gun out, it slows time briefly so you can line up shots.

title: Tune your settings before you roll
body: Guides point to aim assist, subtitles and minimap options as worth setting first. This entry has more settings than any previous one.

sources.label: GamerBolt — 20 things to know before you start

title: Pet the cats
body: Players report that petting a cat gives Jason a small Focus boost. Wholesome and useful.

title: Clear a lot of space
body: Checklists put the download at up to 212 GB. If you're installing today, clear room first, or plan for an external drive.

title: Don't blow early money on cars
body: Series wisdom: anything with wheels can be borrowed for free. Spend early cash on what you can't steal: gear, upgrades and anything that pays you back.

title: Boats beat Vice City traffic
body: Inference from the geography: the city wraps around bays and barrier islands, and the Keys are mostly water. A boat often outruns a car, and cops on the water are scarcer.

title: Hunt legends at night and in bad weather
body: Series tradition: the strangest encounters depend on time and weather. Early UFO reports point to late nights, so revisit spooky spots after 2 a.m. and in storms.

title: Break line of sight, then go quiet
body: Series fundamentals: get out of sight first, then hide. Alleys, parking garages and tunnels are your friends. Pair it with an outfit and car swap.
